Google.patterns: Focused on Data Structures & Algorithms, Open-ended problem solving, and Googleiness (culture fit).
Google.strategy: Master LeetCode Medium/Hard. Practice thinking out loud. Study System Design for L4+ roles.
rejection_reasons: Lack of scalability in design answers
technical: How would you implement a distributed cache?
Explain the working of Google Search indexing.
Given a large stream of data, find the top K frequent elements.
hr: Why Google?
Tell me about a time you had a conflict with a teammate.
How do you handle ambiguity in projects?
gd: Is AI a threat to software engineering jobs?
Privacy vs. Convenience in the digital age.

Amazon.patterns: Heavy emphasis on Leadership Principles. 2-3 coding rounds and a Bar Raiser round.
Amazon.strategy: Prepare 2 stories for each of the 14 Leadership Principles using STAR method. Practice LLD/HLD.
technical: Design an Amazon-scale notification system.
Find the first non-repeating character in a stream.
Implement a LRU Cache.
hr: Tell me about a time you failed and what you learned.
Describe a time you went above and beyond for a customer.
How have you handled a difficult stakeholder?
gd: E-commerce impact on small businesses.
Sustainability in global supply chains.

Infosys.patterns: Initial aptitude test followed by Technical and HR rounds. Focus on basics and projects.
Infosys.strategy: Brush up on OOPs, DBMS, and OS. Be ready to explain your final year project in detail.
technical: What is the difference between Abstraction and Encapsulation?
Explain different types of Joins in SQL.
Write a program to check for Prime numbers.
hr: Why do you want to join Infosys?
Are you willing to relocate?
Where do you see yourself in 5 years?
gd: Work from home vs Work from office.
Digital India initiative.

Microsoft.patterns: Focused on coding accuracy, robust edge-case handling, and architectural fundamentals.
Microsoft.strategy: Master Trees, Graphs, and System Design. Practice writing production-ready, highly readable code.
technical: How would you design a cloud-based document sharing service like OneDrive?
Write a function to detect if a binary tree is balanced.
Explain the differences between processes, threads, and coroutines.
hr: Why Microsoft?
Describe a time you had to adapt to a sudden change in project requirements.
How do you ensure accessibility in the software you build?
gd: The role of tech giants in ethical AI deployment.
Are hybrid work cultures sustainable long-term?

Netflix.patterns: Heavy emphasis on cultural alignment (Netflix Keeper Test), system scalability, and freedom & responsibility.
Netflix.strategy: Read the Netflix Culture Deck thoroughly. Master microservices design and highly scalable caching structures.
technical: How would you design a video streaming delivery network supporting millions of concurrent users?
Explain how you would handle network latency and packet loss in real-time video chunk rendering.
Implement a system that tracks user video progress and generates real-time recommendations.
hr: How do you handle receiving critical constructive feedback?
Tell me about a time you made a major mistake at work and how you communicated it.
What does 'freedom and responsibility' mean to you?
gd: Net neutrality and its impact on digital streaming platforms.
Is personalized algorithm content isolating users?

Meta.patterns: Extremely fast-paced coding rounds (expecting 2 Medium problems in 45 minutes) and a strong behavioral 'Jedi' round.
Meta.strategy: Practice speed-coding. Master Facebook-tagged LeetCode problems. Focus heavily on scale-out system design.
technical: How would you design a global social graph system supporting billions of connections?
Given a binary tree, print its vertical order traversal.
Explain how you would implement a highly scalable News Feed system.
hr: Tell me about your most challenging technical project and how you drove it.
How do you prioritize tasks when you have multiple competing deadlines?
Describe a time you had to work with someone who had a completely different working style.
gd: Social media regulations vs. freedom of speech.
The feasibility of the Metaverse in daily commerce.

Apple.patterns: Highly secretive and deep technical rounds. Expect extreme focus on hardware-software integration, low-level optimization, and design perfection.
Apple.strategy: Master low-level programming, memory management, and elegant UI architecture. Show intense passion for detail.
technical: How would you optimize a memory-constrained embedded system?
Design a highly efficient client-side caching layer for an iOS application.
Explain how a CPU cache hierarchy works and how it affects code optimization.
hr: What is your favorite Apple product and how would you improve it?
Tell me about a time you refused to compromise on the quality of your work.
How do you manage stress and tight deadlines when launching secretive projects?
gd: Consumer privacy rights vs. law enforcement requests for data.
Is hardware innovation slowing down compared to software?

TCS.patterns: Standard aptitude test followed by technical, managerial, and HR interview rounds. Focus on academic basics and project overview.
TCS.strategy: Brush up on DBMS, Software Engineering lifecycle, and basic programming algorithms. Be clear about your resume claims.
technical: What is the difference between primary keys and unique keys in SQL?
Explain the four main pillars of Object-Oriented Programming (OOPs).
Write a basic program to check if a string is a palindrome.
hr: Why do you want to start your career with TCS?
Are you open to working night shifts and relocations?
How do you handle working in large teams?
gd: Digital transformation's impact on employment in developing countries.
Smart Cities: Pros and Cons.

JPMorgan.patterns: Focuses on financial system fundamentals, clean coding standards, Spring Boot architecture, and databases.
JPMorgan.strategy: Master Core Java, Spring Framework, SQL queries, and transactional safety. Practice explaining final year projects.
technical: What are the ACID properties in databases, and how do they ensure transactional safety?
Explain the Spring Boot dependency injection and bean lifecycle.
How would you ensure thread safety when implementing a banking transaction ledger?
hr: Why financial technology (FinTech)?
Describe a situation where you noticed an error in a project and how you resolved it.
How do you stay updated with emerging technologies?
gd: Will digital currencies completely replace paper money?
The role of AI in banking fraud detection.

Stripe.patterns: Extremely pragmatic interview rounds. Focus on writing clean integration code, working with APIs, and reading/debugging codebase code rather than LeetCode puzzles.
Stripe.strategy: Practice working with JSON APIs, HTTP status codes, robust error handling, and writing clean, testable system code.
rejection_reasons: Poor handling of HTTP error edge cases
Weak understanding of API design principles
technical: Design and implement a robust webhook delivery manager.
Write a clean integration function that parses complex JSON payouts and handles API rate limits.
How would you design a payment transaction ledger keeping eventual consistency in mind?
hr: Why Stripe?
Tell me about a time you had to write documentation or explain a complex technical concept to a non-technical stakeholder.
What is your approach to resolving bugs reported by active customers?
gd: The future of global cross-border digital payments.
Cryptocurrency: Speculative asset vs. viable global utility.

Uber.patterns: Focuses heavily on dynamic system scale, concurrency, low-latency algorithms, and strict System Design.
Uber.strategy: Master real-time geospatial designs (Quadtrees/H3 index). Focus heavily on low-latency messaging queues and concurrency.
rejection_reasons: Inability to scale architectures under heavy loads
technical: How would you design a low-latency dispatcher system that matches riders to drivers in real time?
Explain how a geospatial search quadtree index works for location tracking.
Design a highly concurrent distributed rate limiter.
hr: How do you handle severe customer dissatisfaction?
Describe a time you argued for a specific architectural decision and how you reached a consensus.
What motivates you to work on low-latency, real-time dispatch systems?
gd: Autonomous vehicles: The ethical implications of driving AI.
Gig economy: Opportunity for flexibility vs. lack of job security.

Airbnb.patterns: High emphasis on UI excellence, clean architectural components, structural design patterns, and scaling.
Airbnb.strategy: Master React framework, CSS layout architectures, data rendering optimizations, and general System Design.
rejection_reasons: Lack of aesthetic appreciation in UI build tasks
technical: How would you optimize search result rendering on a page with map layouts and dynamic filters?
Design a highly scalable global booking and availability calendar service.
Explain the virtual DOM rendering lifecycle and how to prevent unnecessary renders.
hr: What does 'belonging' mean to you in a workplace?
Describe a project where you went above and beyond to make the user interface beautiful and seamless.
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a product designer and how you resolved it.
gd: The impact of short-term rentals on local housing markets.
Has tourism become more accessible due to online marketplace platforms?

OpenAI.patterns: Strong focus on mathematics, ML scaling limits, PyTorch, algorithmic optimization, and high-performance computation.
OpenAI.strategy: Master Machine Learning core math, deep learning model architectures (Transformers), and deep Python/C++ optimization.
rejection_reasons: Lack of experience in scaling distributed training
Poor low-level CPU/GPU performance coding skills
technical: How would you optimize the distributed training of a multi-billion parameter model across multiple GPUs?
Explain the mathematical framework and backpropagation inside a standard Transformer attention layer.
Given a resource-constrained hardware framework, how would you design an efficient inference engine?
hr: How do you view the ethical implications of artificial general intelligence (AGI)?
Describe a time you pursued a high-risk technical research path that eventually failed, and what you learned.
Why OpenAI?
gd: Should AI model training data be copyrighted?
Will the automation of cognitive tasks improve or diminish human capability?

SpaceX.patterns: Deep embedded technical rounds, hardware integration, real-time concurrency programming, and intense mission alignment.
SpaceX.strategy: Master real-time operating systems (RTOS), C++ optimization, multithreading, and aerospace data streaming.
rejection_reasons: Failure to debug low-level concurrency hazards
technical: How would you design a real-time fault-tolerant flight telemetry streaming system?
Explain how you would prevent race conditions and deadlock hazards in an RTOS embedded framework.
How do you implement low-overhead memory allocations in highly critical real-time code?
hr: SpaceX is known for its intense pace and massive goals. How do you maintain focus and manage burnout?
Tell me about a time you solved an extremely difficult engineering problem with very limited resources.
Why is colonizing Mars important to you?
gd: Private aerospace companies vs. government-funded space exploration.
Should global satellite coverage networks be regulated internationally?
